title: Keep Watch
summary: Songbird asks V to keep watch on a Dogtown water tower roof while she sleeps, and to say honestly what she said.
description: Songbird has not slept in two days. She asks V to keep watch from a water tower roof in Dogtown so she can finally rest.

start.bringUp: Songbird has not slept in two days, and she asks V to stay on a roof and keep watch so she can sleep.

spot.name: the rooftop of a water tower in Dogtown

spot-b.name: a second roof beside the water tower

SBH5.ask.01.text: Did I say anything? Tell me honestly.

g1.asks: Did I say anything? Tell me honestly.
g1.know: What you heard her say in her sleep, a street name and a name.

variations.know: It is raining, and the roof is wet under your boots.
The night is loud, and the streets carry the noise up to the roof.

variations.wants: V falls asleep first, and she watches over V.

stages.label: Songbird sleeps while V keeps watch
stages.objective: Keep watch on the water tower roof while Songbird sleeps
stages.know: V is on the water tower roof in Dogtown. You are going to sleep for the first time in two days, and you are glad it is V who is watching.
stages.wants: V to keep watch quietly and tell you honestly what you said.

honest.memory: You kept watch on the water tower roof while Songbird slept, and told her the truth when she woke.

flattered.memory: You kept watch on the water tower roof while Songbird slept, and told her nothing had been said when something had.

left.memory: You left the water tower roof before Songbird woke, and she never asked what you heard.
